clauses.quote: When the Least Restrictive Environment (as defined by the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act) is a Learning Center, maximum class size shall not exceed the following:
clauses.notes: Sets a ceiling on class size for Learning Centers; follows a conditional clause referencing IDEA.

clauses.quote: Due to the complexities of class size provisions in any contract, the WTU and DCPS agree to form a committee to review the possibility of developing and using a “weighted formula” for determining appropriate class size in DCPS.
clauses.notes: Joint obligation to establish a committee exploring weighted class size formulas to ease class size pressures.

clauses.quote: In addition, this committee will recommend solutions when DCPS is unable to meet the class size provisions.
clauses.notes: Mandates the committee to propose remedies when the district cannot satisfy contractual class size targets.

clauses.quote: Individual Education Plan (IEP) caseloads shall not exceed fifteen (15) per Teacher.
clauses.notes: Caps the number of IEP students assigned to a single teacher.
